$comment: Every input to this project, with its license and terms. Nothing enters the build without an entry here. Review before publishing.

openstreetmap.name: OpenStreetMap
openstreetmap.notes: Derived geographic data remains subject to ODbL. Attribution must be visible in the deployed map.

usgs_3dep_elevation.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM - point samples
usgs_3dep_elevation.notes: Ground elevation for 2,812 routing nodes and 1,173 building centroids; range -0.5 m to 38.5 m. Bare earth - gives terrain, NOT building height. Sampled offline into data/elevation.json, so there is no runtime dependency.

maplibre_gl.name: MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1
maplibre_gl.notes: Served from the repository rather than a CDN, so the map works on restricted networks and carries no third-party runtime dependency. License text at vendor/MAPLIBRE-LICENSE.txt.

fairfax_county_gis.name: Fairfax County GIS open data
fairfax_county_gis.notes: Candidate source for orthoimagery and possibly lidar. Confirm the specific dataset license before any use, including tracing.

mount_vernon_estate.name: Mount Vernon Ladies' Association - institutional data
mount_vernon_estate.notes: Requested: site survey / CAD base plan, building heights and roof forms, garden layouts, accessible route inventory, closures, approved place names, any lidar or drone survey. Supersedes derived data where supplied.

usgs_3dep_hillshade.name: USGS 3DEP Hillshade Multidirectional - WMS raster
usgs_3dep_hillshade.reason: Shaded relief was tried as a base layer and removed by art direction. The map is deliberately flat 2D artwork - hand-tinted washes and crisp ink linework - so terrain shading works against the look.
usgs_3dep_hillshade.note: The point-sampled elevation in data/elevation.json is a separate thing and is still used, for route ascent and gradient advisories. If relief is ever wanted again, the WMS layer was '3DEPElevation:Hillshade Multidirectional' and CORS was open.

google_maps_aerial.name: Google Maps 3D aerial imagery
google_maps_aerial.reason: Tracing geometry from Google Maps imagery violates Google's Terms of Service, and derived data inherits that restriction. This is why OpenStreetMap prohibits Google-derived tracing.
google_maps_aerial.action: Do not port. Garden detail must be re-derived from estate-supplied plans or a licensed imagery source.

eagleview_2025.name: Fairfax County / EagleView 2025 aerial (landscape-2025.geojson)
eagleview_2025.reason: License terms not verified. EagleView imagery is commonly licensed to the county rather than placed in the public domain.
eagleview_2025.action: Confirm terms before porting the 165 tree-candidate features from the prototype.
